Hi James — thanks for the clear list. I put together a quick mapping and some recommended commercial approaches; attaching the CSV (Redwood_SKU_mapping.csv). Below is a concise summary to help with your finance model.

High-level SKU mapping (summary):
- Core nodes (per-node VM/GPU): metered, billed monthly by node-hour (SKU: RD-NODE-GPU)
- Platform fee (one line item): fixed monthly platform entitlement (SKU: RD-PLATFORM-FEE)
- Support retainer: tiered monthly (SKU: RD-SUPPORT-24x5 / RD-SUPPORT-24x7). SME hours above retainer billed hourly (SKU: RD-SME-HOUR)

Amortization options for platform fee:
- Option A (12mo amortization): treat platform fee as a capitalized asset amortized monthly over 12 months — equivalent monthly impact = platform_fee / 12
- Option B (36mo amortization): amortize over 36 months for lower monthly burden; we typically allow this for customers who commit to multi-year reserved capacity
- Tradeoff: amortization reduces monthly P&L impact but does not reduce total cash paid; if Helios prefers lower cash outlay, we can offer a time-limited onboarding credit (one-time) in lieu of a platform-fee discount

Support tiers (what's included):
- 24x5: ticketing + monitoring, escalation to SE during business hours, monthly operational review; SLA response times vary by severity (see CSV)
- 24x7: includes pager-based incident response, timed on-call escalation to our SREs, higher included SME hours for runbooks/runbook updates
- SME hours: support retainer includes a base set of SME hours (12/month for 24x5; 40/month for 24x7). Excess billed at RD-SME-HOUR. We can optionally move more SME hours into the retainer to simplify billing

Suggested commercial proposals to present to your finance team:
1) Standard: platform fee billed monthly; allow 12mo amortization in your models. No onboarding credit.
2) Multi-year commit (recommended): 10% discount on platform fee + allow 36mo amortization if you sign a 24-month reserved commitment for nodes.
3) Onboarding credit: one-time credit equal to 15% of first-year platform fee; does not recur. Useful if Helios wants lower cash at T0 without changing ARR math.

Next steps: I can share the formal SOW appendix with line-item SKUs updated and a short explanatory note for your finance team. Would you prefer we 1) update the SOW and send a redline or 2) set a quick 30-min call with finance/legal to walk through?

Thanks,
Olga

Marissa / David — FYI thread from Helios procurement (DEAL-2026-045). They asked for SKU mapping and amortization options; I sent the CSV and three commercial approaches (standard, multi-year commit, onboarding credit).

A few internal points and asks before I send the updated SOW appendix:
- Margin check: multi-year commit w/ 10% platform discount + 36mo amortization — what's the blended margin assuming their expected node commit is 48 nodes? (Marissa, can you run model?)
- Onboarding credit: proposal = one-time credit equal to 15% of year-1 platform fee. This preserves ARR and gives them lower cash at T0. Approve? (David)
- Support banding: they asked about moving more SME hours into the retainer. If we move to include 20 SME hrs/mo on 24x5 for this deal, is that still profitable vs billing overage? (Hannah)

Suggested negotiation position to present to Helios: lead with multi-year commit offer (option 2) — it gives Helios the lowest ongoing unit cost and us guaranteed utilization. If they push on cash at T0, offer the onboarding credit as a fallback (non-recurring).

If you approve, I'll update the SOW appendix with SKU rows and the optional onboarding credit clause and send to James + legal. Need a green light by EOD tomorrow to meet their Friday cadence.

Olga

Olga — thanks for the fast turnaround and the CSV. Our finance team reviewed the options and prefers Option A (12mo amortization) for P&L simplicity; that keeps our monthly run-rate predictable. That said we are open to the multi-year commit if you can provide a written example of the monthly impact (spread) for 24 vs 36 months — a single table would be ideal.

We would also accept the onboarding credit approach instead of discounting the platform fee, provided the credit is clearly one-time and appears as an invoice-level credit during year one. Can you add a short clause to the SOW appendix that: 1) lists the onboarding credit amount, 2) states it is non-recurring, and 3) lists treatment in invoicing?

Finally, for support tiers: Helios legal wants the SLA bullets for 24x5 vs 24x7 included in the commercial appendix (not just referenced). Can you include the SLA summary lines in the appendix and we'll pass to legal for the redline?

We can do a 30-minute call Thursday 7/23 at 11am PT to confirm a final position and get an updated SOW from you. If that works, I'll have our legal join for a quick redline.

Best,
James Park
Procurement Lead | Helios Health
